title: All She Wants For Christmas Is YOU
description:
The Christmas Demon Is HERE

Every Christmas she breaks out of her icy tomb and goes hunting for blood. Unfortunately, you're her only target.

GameplayThe House

Stuck at home, use what you have around you to thrwart her attack! Perhaps you may lower the AC so low that she refreezes, or maybe you'll burn her to the ground. This map contains 12 unique endings! Some involve her death, some yours, and many more!

Once you've proven your skill, you can unlock the nightmare mode. A much more challenging house map with randomized enemies, a stronger AI, and so much more. The nightmare mode is challenging, but so are your treasures at the end of each round.

The School

Much like the house, this time you're stuck at school after hours when she attacks. Perhaps you'll hide in a locker or knock her with a dodgeball. Maybe you'll find a way to scare her to death. This map also contains brand new endings and a nightmare mode!

You can expect each round to last a few minutes, you'll be challenged with moving around, hunting her down, and solving puzzles all the way through.

The Library

Even though the library is closed for the night, the robotic librarian is keeping a watchful eye. Don't get too loud or she'll hunt you down, making it infinitely easier for Amber Lee to get you! Discover 12 unique endings, whether its killing Amber Lee yourself or hacking the robot to do your dirty work... Spend the night knocking over bookshelves, crashing chandeliers, and so much more...

Frostfall Park

Frostfall park is a romantic destination for some... but the start of a war for others. Navigate through this quiet outdoor park, checking every corner to make sure you're safe... Will you ride the Frostwheel, climb some wires, or maybe you'll hide in a maze. Unravel the story and learn about Amber's true past...

But thats not all...

Every Christmas a new map (and more) will be released FOR FREE! Stay tuned!
description_short: When the clock strikes midnight, the Christmas demon will be at your door. Trapped at home, you must discover what's around you to survive the night and thwart her terror.
